Settle into a position that feels easy. Let your hands rest, and let your shoulders drop away from your ears.
[pause 47]
[repeat 3]
[in 4] Breathe in
[out 6] And out, slowly
[/repeat]
Today's practice: noticing thoughts.
[pause 46]
Bring to mind a recent moment when you felt anxious about intimacy, nothing too intense.
[pause 50]
Notice the thoughts that came with it. You might hear, "What if it happens again?"
[pause 50]
Now, silently add the words: "I'm having the thought that..." in front of it.
[pause 50]
Notice the small gap that creates. You are the one noticing the thought. You are not the thought.
[pause 50]
Take a slow breath, and notice how you feel now compared with when you started.
[pause 49]
Confidence grows with practice, not perfection.
Take a moment to thank yourself for this time. Then, in your own time, open your eyes.
[chime]
